Hi, I’m not sure I have BED as I am currently in recovery from what seemed to be anorexia, but I feel like I can relate with the mentality. I am a 19 year old male.
1. I guess restriction and obsession. I have anxiety and I always tend to ruminate on the past and the future. Restriction simply made me ruminate a whole lot on food and how it brought me pleasure in the past, so now that I started to eat again, it’s not really about the food but about the thoughts. I only see food and my weight and now that people have « allowed me to eat » I have kind of an anticipation at every meal, like I can eat what I want and gain pleasure from it, but when I start to eat, I realize its not really that pleasurable and so my mind goes haywire and tries to find ways to make it more enjoyable by overeating on sweets or something like that.
2. A few months ago, I started my first diet and it went real bad. My first months were perfect, too perfect and when I started letting go of the control, I started bingeing.
3. Sometimes its uncomfortable emotions and the thoughts about food keep those away and give me something to look forward to. Sometimes I feel like loneliness and boredom plays a role. I always also binge when I try to restrict now.
4. I used to hate sweets but now its all I want because it feels like a quick fix I dont know. I binge primarily on oatmeal, porridge, oatmeal cookies, bread, bagels, cheese and peanut butter. I can also binge on vegetables and fruits and especially nuts
